testimonials.title1: 他们信赖我们的作品与

elena.headline: 真正交付成果的专业团队
elena.quote: 电影级品质瞬间提升了我们的品牌认知。主视觉战役的互动率在首周便大幅攀升, 画面质感高级、意图明确，令人无法划走。

james.headline: 如同院线预告的发布片
james.quote: Starlights 交付的发布片如同院线预告，而非产品广告。付费社交留存率翻倍，该创意成为此后每场战役的标杆。

amara.headline: 全球截止日下的精准工艺
amara.quote: 从分镜到最终调色，团队对工艺与期限把控精准如手术。我们发布了全球战役，播放量超 200 万，品牌提升至今仍被领导层在董事会引用。

hauke.headline: Efficient, reliable, and highly recommended
hauke.quote: Starlight Visuals supported us in creating a CGI video for SmarAct Automation, with the goal of presenting our core competencies in a clear, professional, and visually engaging way. The collaboration was highly efficient and reliable from start to finish. We especially appreciated the fast response times, quick turnaround, strong communication, and dependable delivery of the final files. Our requirements were understood quickly and implemented professionally. We are very satisfied with the result and can confidently recommend Starlight Visuals for high quality CGI and visual content projects.

aboutPage.metaDescription: Starlights Visuals is a passionate creative studio specializing in cinematic 2D animation, high quality 3D animation, and VFX.
aboutPage.label: Who We Are
aboutPage.p1: Starlights Visuals is a passionate creative studio at the intersection of animation, VFX, and cinematic storytelling. We exist to bring imagination to life, whether that is a hand crafted 2D series, a photoreal 3D trailer, or a brand campaign that needs to feel premium.
aboutPage.p2: From our concept artists and 3D sculptors to our motion designers and compositors, every member of our team is obsessed with one thing: making audiences feel something. We do not just build pretty pixels, we build worlds people want to live in.
aboutPage.p3: We partner with indie creators, AAA studios, and global brands to deliver work that punches above its weight, hits deadlines without compromise, and looks like it cost twice the budget.

imagination.title: Imagination First
imagination.desc: Every project starts with a bold idea and a blank canvas.

craft.title: Craft Obsessed
craft.desc: Frame by frame, pixel by pixel, quality is non negotiable.

energy.title: Cinematic Energy
energy.desc: We chase the goosebumps. If it doesn't move us, we refine.

blogPage.label: 工作室日志
blogPage.subtitle: 关于电影级工艺、制作流程与驱动转化的视觉思考。
blogPage.postBody1: 在 Starlights Visuals，我们将每一帧视为转化机会, 而非仅仅是精美画面。本文深入探讨我们 {{category}} 作品背后的思路，以及区分优秀创意与可上线创意的关键决策。
blogPage.postBody2: Whether you are shipping a trailer, scaling a brand motion system, or building campaign visuals for a live product, the same principle applies: clarity of story first, polish second, and ruthless editing last. That discipline is how teams hit deadlines without the almost there feeling.
blogPage.postBody3: 想将这一思路应用于您的下一个项目？我们很乐意了解您正在打造的内容, 发送简报，我们将规划从概念到交付的电影级路径。

accordionPage.metaDescription: 从首次需求简报到最终交付，这里汇总了与我们合作所需了解的一切。
accordionPage.label: 常见问题
accordionPage.title: 问题与解答
accordionPage.subtitle: 从首次需求简报到最终交付，这里汇总了与我们合作所需了解的一切。

01.question: 你们承接哪些类型的项目？
01.answer: We produce animation, VFX, cinematics, motion graphics, product films, and brand films for film, series, advertising, and DTC brands. Briefs range from single hero assets to full campaign packages.

02.question: Starlights Visuals 的所在地在哪里？
02.answer: 我们是远程优先工作室，团队成员分布在多个时区。我们与全球客户协作，通过结构化异步流程和实时评审交付可直接投入制作的资产。

03.question: 如何启动一个项目？
03.answer: 请通过联系表单提交需求简报、时间计划和参考链接。我们会安排一次需求沟通电话，明确项目范围，并发送包含里程碑和交付物的提案。

01.question: 你们提供哪些服务？
01.answer: Our core services include 2D and 3D animation, VFX, character and concept art, motion graphics, product animation, and cinematic trailers. We can handle individual disciplines or full pipeline production.

02.question: 你们会与独立团队和大型工作室合作吗？
02.answer: Yes. We partner with indie creators, mid size studios, and global brands. Scope and team size flex to match your budget and timeline without compromising craft.

03.question: 你们可以匹配我们现有的美术风格吗？
03.answer: Absolutely. We start with style frames and a look development pass aligned to your brand guidelines or visual world before committing to full production.

01.question: 常见项目周期是多久？
01.answer: 周期取决于项目范围——社媒短剪通常需要 1 到 2 周，完整电影化内容通常需要 4 到 8 周。我们会在每份提案中明确里程碑。

02.question: 修改流程如何进行？
02.answer: 每个里程碑都包含明确的修改轮次。我们会在结构化评审中集中整理反馈，确保修改高效并按计划推进。

03.question: 你们交付哪些文件格式？
03.answer: 我们按你的流程交付可直接使用的格式：视频为 MP4/MOV，按需提供 PNG/EXR 序列，应要求提供分层源文件，以及实时项目所需的引擎可用资产。
